# workflows.Schedule

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A tenant schedule that starts a schedulable workflow on a cron expression in an IANA time zone.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `workflows.Schedule` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.schedule.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the schedule was created (UTC). |  |
| `createdBy` | yes | `personal` | Creator; every run re-authorizes this user. |  |
| `cron` | yes | `none` | 5-field cron expression, evaluated in `timezone`. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | `schedule_<tenant key>-<slug>`; the tenant key is the first 16 hex digits of SHA-256(tenantId), because Mastra slugifies ids. |  |
| `inputData` | yes | `personal` | Workflow input; validated by the workflow's own schema on the server. |  |
| `lastFireAt` | yes | `none` | Last fire (UTC); null before the first. |  |
| `nextFireAt` | yes | `none` | Next fire (UTC); null while paused. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `paused` schedules do not fire. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization that owns the schedule. |  |
| `timezone` | yes | `none` | IANA time zone of the cron expression. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the schedule last changed (UTC). |  |
| `workflowId` | yes | `none` | Scheduled workflow. |  |

## Relations

- `belongs-to` `tenancy.Organization` via `tenantId`
